# Prepare 12: Information Types (P-12)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Prepare (P), system level |
| Phases | Materiel Solution Analysis (PH-MSA) (primary) |
| Depends on | Prepare 10: Asset Identification (P-10) |
| Inputs | Hardware and software inventory (ART-INV), Product material (EXT-PRODUCT), Capability requirements documents (EXT-CAPDOC) |
| Outputs | Information types and information life cycle (ART-INFOTYPES), produces |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PM/SO (PER-PM), IO (PER-IO), Privacy (PER-PRIV) · A: PM/SO (PER-PM) · C: ISSM (PER-ISSM), ISSO (PER-ISSO), Sponsor (PER-SPONSOR) · I: — · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [PM/SO (PER-PM)](../../personas/PER-PM.md), [IO (PER-IO)](../../personas/PER-IO.md), [Privacy (PER-PRIV)](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [ISSM (PER-ISSM)](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md), [ISSO (PER-ISSO)](../../personas/PER-ISSO.md), [Sponsor (PER-SPONSOR)](../../personas/PER-SPONSOR.md) |

Purpose: Identify the types of information the system processes, stores and transmits, including whether it processes PII.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: P-12 is the next action, and
   P-10 is done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/P.yaml`):
   - ART-INV identifies the assets and the data they hold.
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what P-12 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   P-12 feeds MS-A (Milestone A, milestone); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step P
   (Prepare) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: P-12`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-INFOTYPES** (Information types and information life cycle): Information types processed, stored and transmitted, their provisional impact levels and life-cycle stages.
     Read `templates/artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md`, replace every `<<FILL: ...>>` placeholder, delete the template
     comment, and write `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md` with `produced_by_task: P-12` and
     `touched_by: [P-12]`.
     Write `artifacts/data/infotypes.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/infotypes.schema.json`); summarize its records in the Markdown by ID instead of copying them.
   Why: `rmf status` counts P-12 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
   Each `INF-*` record also carries (CATG-003): `selection_basis` (the mission or business
   function it supports and the governance that applies to it, SP 800-60 Vol. I 4.1);
   `pii_identification` when `privacy: true` (how the PII was found, identifiers that
   identify only in combination included); `system_information: true` for routing tables,
   password files, key management and configuration and security policy information, which
   is then held at the level of the most sensitive user information (FIPS 199, CATG-002);
   and `handling`: `classification`, `cui`, `cti`, `software_artifacts` (source code, build
   scripts, SBOMs, test vectors or design documents with a military or space application)
   and other `special` handling (Privacy Act, trade secret, critical infrastructure). When
   a type holds CTI, write the top-level `cti` record: the impact of its exposure on
   unclassified networks, its protection under DFARS 252.204-7012 (or the
   252.204-7000(a)(3) exemption), whether the agreements carry the DoDI 8582.01 terms, and
   losses from incidents reported under those contracts (DoDI 5000.83).
   For a system of records, set `privacy.sorn.contractor_operated: true` when contractors
   operate the system, or the hosting, database or cluster holding the records, on the
   agency's behalf (Privacy Act (m)); contractor development alone does not count. P-15
   then carries the contract provisions (PRIV-007).
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** P-12 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-12`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-PM (Program Manager / System Owner) | R, A | start here |
| PER-IO (Information Owner / Steward) | R | start here |
| PER-PRIV (Component Privacy Officer) | R | start here, only when the system processes PII |
| PER-ISSM (Information System Security Manager) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-12`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

## Inputs

- ART-INV (Hardware and software inventory): `artifacts/ART-INV.md`, `artifacts/data/inventory.yaml`
- EXT-PRODUCT (Product material): files in the run's product directory, cited as
  `product/<path>#<anchor>`.
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md` | `artifact_id: ART-INFOTYPES`, `produced_by_task: P-12`, `touched_by: [P-12]` | template `templates/artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md` |
| `artifacts/data/infotypes.yaml` | — | schema `infotypes`, written whole |

## Facts

P-12 writes no facts.

## Done when

- The types of information processed, stored and transmitted by the system are identified (DoDI 8510.01 Table 1 outcome).
- ART-INFOTYPES and infotypes.yaml list each information type with its SP 800-60 identifier and provisional impact levels.
- The determination of whether the system processes PII is recorded for approval by the SAOP or designee.
- For a system processing PII, each PII information type records whom the PII is about and whether it holds PHI or SSNs, and infotypes.yaml privacy records the issuances its handling complies with (DoD 5400.11-R, DoDI 5400.16, DoD 8580.02-R for PHI), the SORN, the SSN justification, records coordination and the PIA determination with its DoDI 5400.16 basis and due date (PRIV-001).
- `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md` lists P-12 in `touched_by` and has `produced_by_task: P-12`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-12`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-12` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task P-12`, naming what the outputs now hold.
- A fix that took more than one `rmf check` round gets a RETRY entry and a lesson
  (`_shared/journaling-and-lessons.md`).
